editorial:
Imagine finding a glowing hole in the ground and suddenly gaining the power to move things with your mind. That is exactly what happens to three high school buddies in this flick. It feels like you are watching a home movie because it is filmed from their own cameras. You get to see them start off as just kids having fun, playing pranks and flying around the city. But as they get stronger, the vibe shifts from a fun hangout to something much scarier. It really makes you wonder what you would do if you had no rules to follow and total power over everyone around you.

The acting feels very real, especially the main guy who goes through a dark change. The action scenes are great because the camera shakes and moves with the characters, making you feel like you are right there in the fight. While some parts of the story move a bit slow at the start, the ending is a wild ride that keeps you on edge. You should definitely check this out if you like stories about superheroes gone wrong.
endingExplained: The movie ends in a massive fight in downtown Seattle. Andrew has completely lost it and starts attacking people. His friends try to stop him, but he is too strong. In the final moments, Andrew is badly hurt and realizes he cannot win. He uses his last bit of strength to fly high into the sky, essentially sacrificing himself to stop the chaos. He dies as a tragic figure who just wanted to be loved.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves superhero stories with a dark twist.
